description: This file defines the Cosine class which provides static methods for various trigonometric and hyperbolic cosine functions, including validation and array handling features for use within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

classes.name: Cosine
classes.description: Provides static methods for cosine, hyperbolic cosine, and inverse cosine functions with validation support, used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: cos
methods.description: Calculates the cosine of a number, with support for arrays and validation.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cosine of a number, with support for arrays and validation.

methods.name: acos
methods.description: Calculates the arccosine of a number, with support for arrays and validation.

methods.name: acosh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number, with support for arrays and validation.
